dct_creator_sm: Homa Kheyrollah Pour, Wilfrid Laurier University.
dct_description_sm: The seasonal dynamics of freshwater lake ice and its interactions with air and snow were studied in a small subarctic lake near Yellowknife, Northwest Territories. A 2.9 m long thermistor chain sensor (Snow and Ice Mass Balance Apparatus; SIMBA), was used to remotely measure air, snow, ice, and water temperatures every 15-min between October-December 2021-2023. This dataset includes raw measurements of ice thicknesses and snow depths from the SIMBA at 15-minute intervals. Users intending to use these data for publications, reports, or other research outputs are requested to contact the Principal Investigator (PI) prior to use. Potential collaboration and co-authorship should be discussed where the data contribute substantially to the resulting work.
dct_title_s: CIMP 238: Thermistor-derived measurements of snow depths and ice thicknesses (October-December, 2021-2023) in Landing Lake, Northwest Territories
